name: Talk to the City
tagline: Open-source LLM survey tool to improve collective discourse and decision-making by analyzing qualitative responses and generating easy-to-navigate reports
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
policy_outcomes: Adopted by municipal governments for public consultation
Used by Taiwan AI Assembly for deliberation workshops analyzing 2,000+ opinions from 400 participants
Deployed by Silent Cry non-profit to explore reentry challenges for formerly incarcerated people
Used in 2024 Deliberative Technology in Polarized Contexts workshop at Notre Dame University with peacebuilders and mediators
failure_modes: Inaccurate AI summarization of nuanced positions
Potential for manipulation of input data
curation_criteria: Community input moderation guidelines available on platform documentation
contributor_governance: Open contribution model with review process
government_partnerships: Municipal government partnerships for participatory budgeting
political_relevance_summary: Talk to the City addresses democratic participation and citizen engagement. Open-source LLM survey tool to improve collective discourse and decision-making by analyzing qualitative responses and generating easy-to-navigate reports.

movement_building_utility.notes: Directly supports organizing, mobilization, or democratic participation processes.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication; already deployed across multiple jurisdictions; replication materials are available.
